decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables unit fits the firm's growth and sustainability direction, and its upgrade from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 suggests results met aspirations in a growing market, with slack from expansion to carry it.

Crew travel management is closely tied to the firm's core crewing business and had its own page in 2019, though pandemic travel disruption may have pushed results below aspiration and raises some risk of it being folded back.

An online vessel information portal supports client proximity and continued digitalisation of ship management, and costs little to run, so an expanding firm has little reason to search for alternatives.

The mobile performance app supports cleaner, more efficient shipping, but standalone apps are often replaced or merged into portals, which gives a moderate drop risk even though slack favours keeping it.
